messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: notify-service -> pagerflow failed deliveries spike: 47% errors in last 5m; suppressor engaged, pages suppressed. svc=notify-pagerflow, region=eu-west-1
maria: saw the alert, investigating now
kevin: reproducing 504s hitting /v1/pager/send from our staging proxy
maria: logs show SuppressorFilter.parse_rules throwing on header 'x-route' — looks like a bad regex parse after this morning's deploy
jin: @kevin which deploy rolled earlier today?
kevin: platform/notify rev f3a2 at 2023-11-14T14:01 — included a regex tweak to suppressor rules
lena: can we disable the suppressor while we fix the rule? need fast recovery so customers get pages
maria: on it — flipping feature flag: 
  kubectl -n notify set env deployment/notify-pagerflow SUPPRESSOR_ENABLED=false
maria: patch applied, scaling rollout initiated
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout started for notify-pagerflow by maria
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout succeeded (f3a2 -> f3a3)
jin: testing now — pages flowing, error rate down to ~1.2% in the last minute
maria: good. switching to manual paging for critical alerts for 20m while we revert the regex
kevin: opened PR to revert the regex change: https://github.com/redwood/notify/pull/482 — requesting urgent review
oncall-liaison: I'm taking handoff, will monitor PagerDuty and support. Notifying CS to double-check any customer misses
lena: noted. support, can you confirm any customers reported missed pages in past 30m?
kevin: initial check: ~150 pages were suppressed across multiple accounts during the 25m window; no P1s confirmed yet but some missed SMS for monitoring integrations
maria: quick incident summary: root cause = overly-greedy suppressor regex broke header parsing; impact = suppressed pages (est. 150) for ~25 minutes; mitigation = disabled suppressor, manual paging, PR reverted; follow-ups = add unit tests for suppressor, feature-flag guard, alert for suppression-rate threshold
kevin: filing an incident ticket and retro, attaching timeline and logs
maria: thanks everyone — keeping thread open until PR merged and confirmation from support. marking for follow-up by eng-platform after rollback :white_check_mark:
